dek: Kingsoft's WPS has quietly launched Lingxi Pro, a standalone AI-native office agent that makes AI the first entry point instead of a document feature. Integrated with the WPS cloud document ecosystem's 678 million monthly active devices, it turns skills into native, editable Word and PPT files and supports custom model
